terra.problem: The blessing also applies to one who maintains justice, does what is right, and keeps his hand from doing evil; Sabbath-keeping alone is not the full description.
The eunuchs are also described as choosing what pleases the LORD and holding fast to His covenant.
The foreigners are also described as joining themselves to the LORD to minister to Him, love His name and be His servants, and as keeping the Sabbath without profaning it.
